releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.HashgraphOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Hedera Hashgraph -- aBFT DLT using the hashgraph DAG algorithm with 10,000+ TPS and fixed low fees governed by the Hedera Council. Stores OASIS holons, avatars, and tokens. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add Hedera CQL controls and fix cross-platform Solidity runtime metadata drift (366acb5)
- Admit Hedera paid queries under aggregate signed fee budgets (54ce56a)
- Admit reviewed Hedera standalone signed fee maxima (b6833ca)
- Always validate Hedera signed original identity before submission (deaff27)
- Bind Hedera consensus status to requested native identity (4d726f8)
- Bind Hedera mirror status to original unscheduled parent outcome (b977124)
- Bind Hedera recovered fees to original SDK signed payload hashes (e245c49)
- Bound concurrent Hedera public reads within the caller deadline (068d266)
- Bound native storage correlations and document approved operation fee policy (2acf0a8)
- Classify malformed chain storage responses as terminal data failures (3bd4342)
- feat(escrow): reuse per-deposit custody for TRON and Hedera contracts (cd54a76)
- feat(hedera): add explicit escrow association and verify fungible token type (4c94c5e)
- feat(hedera): add per-deposit SDK escrow branch and package its modules (010cd4f)
- feat(hedera): expose explicit wallet-backed escrow association (0d10032)
- feat(hedera): expose verified original fees to central recovery (8500128)
- feat(hedera): wire captured per-deposit intent into token provider (5df5b84)
- feat(wallet): map native transaction metadata into existing search contracts (35161ac)
- Filter Hedera native fee recovery to original parent records (89aed94)
- Fix generated Solidity schema initialization with shared compiler-verified emitter (39df56f)
- fix(hedera): implement nearby queries over real stored records (039f5cc)
- fix(hedera): preserve NFT minter and recipient wallet errors (ab116fe)
- fix(hedera): preserve treasury wallet failures and token intent (a893413)
- fix(hedera): retain wallet failure evidence through shared result helper (86af532)
- fix(hedera): reuse captured NFT mint intent and recipient evidence (9437055)
- fix(providers): share aggregate escrow request integrity checks (e12813e)
- HoloNET: keep Chaos.NaCl private and ship its DLL in the Cardano/Hashgraph provider packages (no dependency on the nonexistent NuGet Chaos.NaCl 1.0.0); live release script uses the dedicated legacy-hApp fixture in HoloNET Client.Tests/Fixtures (4afe222)
- Honor explicit Hedera query payment ceilings and fence native probe (c13ccdc)
- Honor Hedera mirror block history bounds without paid storage activation (d93644a)
- Implement bounded selected-request admission for Hedera paid queries (d0d02ae)
- Implement Hedera mirror account CQL and shared manager demo (2894b60)
- Integrate verified Hedera native storage conformance (f95e0a0)
- Keep Hedera activation read-only and prove routed native storage ownership (1c76ce2)
- Keep synchronous Hedera mirror balance independent of the caller context (cee82cc)
- Normalize real Hedera SDK node inventory for prepared queries (3598db9)
- Persist admitted Hedera encrypted storage attempts before submission (58541b2)
- Persist independently verified Hedera query payments through bounded request sequences (6b2cf84)
- Persist original Hedera and TRON authority before native submission (7f4d3c3)
- Preserve NFT transfer wallet intent across asynchronous provider calls (7e42a20)
- Preserve safe Hedera query cap diagnostics across SDK process boundary (b9c405f)
- Propagate admitted Hedera scope cancellation into SDK processes (a961c48)
- Prove actual Hedera paid-query signing and request boundaries offline (dfd80a1)
- Qualify scoped Hedera diagnostics on Development base (e86d5a7)
- Recover original Hedera query debits without double-counting transfer principal (773ed4d)
- Reject colliding Solidity schema names through shared provider validation (55d0f95)
- Reject empty native source generation instead of reporting false success (236d454)
- Share immutable native recovery identity capture across providers (0f356fd)
- test(hedera): prove encrypted wallet escrow through real SDK process (d86106b)
- test(hedera): verify per-deposit SDK transport and paid query exposure (5f5ce36)
- Track paid reads inside prepared Hedera storage scopes with explicit policy (72affa0)
- Verify Hedera contract query cost rejection before paid transport (24756e1)
